title: dryopteris azorica
intro: Dryopteris azorica, commonly known as Azorean shield fern, is a species of fern native to the Azores Islands in Portugal. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris azorica are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Dryopteris azorica for medicinal purposes.
